# Bundle News

> > Bundle is a multi-language news aggregation platform partnering with major publishers like TechCrunch, Bloomberg, National Geographic, and Business Insider to deliver curated content.

Bundle News operates across multiple markets including English, German, and Turkish-speaking regions, offering personalized news discovery through mobile apps. The platform emphasizes publisher partnerships and content curation to deliver quality journalism from trusted sources.

## Key Topics

- News aggregation
- Publisher partnerships
- Content curation
- Mobile news app
- TechCrunch

## Platform Overview

- [Entdecken | Bundle News](https://about.bundle.app/de): German homepage for Bundle news aggregation app
- [Keşfet | Bundle News](https://about.bundle.app/tr/kesfet): Turkish discovery page for Bundle's news platform features
- [Entdecken | Bundle News](https://about.bundle.app/de/entdecken): German discover page showcasing Bundle's news aggregation features
- [Numbers | Bundle News](https://about.bundle.app/en/numbers): User statistics and metrics page showing Bundle's reach and partners
